revisionRemark: This is to inform that we had filed shareholding pattern for the quarter ended 30th June 2023 in XBRL mode to the stock exchange on 11th July 2023. It is observed that there was a typo error in the name of the shareholder in the said shareholding pattern under the Mutual Fund - more than one percent category. The name of the shareholder was inadvertently mentioned as PGIM India Trustee Private Limited A/c - PGIM India Small Cap Fund instead of Nippon Life India Trustee Ltd A/c - Nippon India Small Cap Fund. Except the name of the shareholder, all other details mentioned in the said shareholding pattern were correct.
